# Signet Artists

> Signet Artists delivers music for your event in Denver, Colorado and surrounding areas. A variety of genre's and configurations are available to book - effortlessly. All sized to your event and budget, for private events across Colorado. Contact us with the date and the venue - and we take care of  the rest.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, BOULDER, and the mountain corridor. No prices are published: what the pricing page carries is what live music costs in this market, each figure with the source it came from, and a night is priced when a date is checked.

## Credits

Trusted and booked by Amazon, NBCUniversal, Charles Schwab, Kroger, Denver Art Museum, Sheraton, Hyatt, Washington Nationals, Casa Bonita and Monarch Casino Resort Spa Black Hawk. Also Live Nation, Valley Country Club and the National Cherry Blossom Festival, and the stages at Dazzle, the Bluebird Theater, Cervantes, the 9:30 Club and many, many more.

## Acts

- Tejas Singh (Singer-songwriter covers, fronted by Tejas Singh): Authentic and intimate with a specialty in building familiar songs from the ground up with his amazing ear and looping tech, Tejas brings a wide variety of fan favorite songs and is also available to play his original, singer-songwriter material to your event. Configurations: Duo to quartet. https://signetartists.com/artists/tejas-singh/
- Jazz Duo (Jazz standards, Upright bass and guitar): Class it up with jazz standards on upright bass and guitar, bring immediate sophistication to any cocktail hour or special event. The Signet Jazz duo specializes in music for when guests arrive, sip cocktails or enjoy dinner. This act is the perfect musical glue that holds the night together effortlessly. The volume and genre sit perfectly under riveting conversations. Configurations: Duo to trio. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/jazz-duo-trio/
- Dirty Flamenco (Flamenco, fronted by Gary Meyers): Brilliant, guitar-based flamenco musical act and one of the only in Colorado available for private events. Dirty flamenco plays real palos, and rhumba both authentically and with a soulful twist. Their polished as a working group is matched by their extensive standing repertoire. Configurations: Trio, larger by request. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/flamenco-trio/
- Funk Trio to quartet (Funk and soul, Guitar, bass, drums): Instrumental funk and soul covers at trio size, for a party where the dance floor is close to the tables. Configurations: Trio. https://signetartists.com/music/
- DJ (Open format, Decks, and a PA sized to the venue): Book a DJ on their own or to carry a late night set after the band steps wraps their set. All run by the same team, with the same contract. A solid DJ gets people moving and is the most common single booking of the corporate season. Configurations: solo to duo. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/dj/
- Blues Rock (Blues, rock and roots, One voice and a guitar, or two): Blues and rock covers and originals, a solo or up to a quartet. Real, seasoned players rather than a spotify playlist, at whatever volume makes the venue sing. Rehearsal dinners, welcome drinks, office parties, and any event where live blues and rock is the right idea. Configurations: Solo to quartet. https://signetartists.com/music/
- Last Consulate (Instrumental downtempo, Upright bass, guitar and electronics, one player): One player, upright bass and guitar out front, over downtempo electronics with slow hip-hop drums, worn keys and delayed guitar. Jazz improvisation on top, at conversation volume. Arrival, cocktails and dinner, on original material that sounds closer to an early-2000s downtempo record than to a jazz set. Configurations: Solo. https://signetartists.com/music/

## Pricing

Signet Artists publishes no price list, no starting prices and no hourly figures. Actual prices vary by date, size, hours and location. https://signetartists.com/pricing/ sets out what live music costs in this market, with each figure attributed to the public source it came from, so a budget can be set before anyone writes. To get the number for a specific night, send the date: https://signetartists.com/contact/

Travel beyond the Denver metro, a night's lodging past the passes, holiday weekends and New Year's Eve are quoted as their own lines rather than folded into a headline figure.
